metadata.name: Bohm et al. 2020 EC and Noah-MP model datasets for Katharinentalerhof, Pforzheim
metadata.description: A collection of metadata entries for various data files (EC measurements, plant performance data, weather data, and Noah-MP model outputs) associated with the Katharinentalerhof site in Pforzheim, Germany. Includes file names, formats, sizes, URLs, event location, and geographic coordinates.
